sloka: पदानुगाश्च ये राज्ञस्तां श्रुत्वा गीतिसम्पदम् ।अवाङ्मुखाश्च दीनाश्च ह्याश्चर्यमिति चाब्रुवन् ।। ७.७१.१८ ॥
transliteration: padānugāśca ye rājñastāṁ śrutvā gītisampadam ।avāṅmukhāśca dīnāśca hyāścaryamiti cābruvan ।। 7.71.18 ॥

translations.english: And the king's followers, having heard that excellent song, became downcast and distressed, exclaiming, "This is indeed a wonder!"
